discription: A rich, detuned saw wave synth with a classic ADSR envelope and a resonant low-pass filter for expressive control over timbre.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, pan=0, detune=0.003, cutoff=2000, rq=0.5;    var sig, env, filterFreq;    env = EnvGen.ar(        Env.adsr(0.01, 0.2, 0.7, 0.5, curve: -4),        gate: gate,        doneAction: 2    );    sig = Saw.ar(freq) + Saw.ar(freq * (1 + detune));    sig = sig * 0.5;    filterFreq = (cutoff + (env * 5000)).clip(20, 20000);    sig = RLPF.ar(sig, filterFreq, rq);    sig = sig * amp * env;    Out.ar(out, Pan2.ar(sig, pan));}
